description: Kadro and Askida dependency updates: weekly, grouped, never merged automatically. Security alerts open pull requests outside the schedule.

packageRules.description: One weekly pull request for every minor and patch update of the npm dependencies, except the Expo SDK family below.
Expo SDK packages move together with the SDK release (the overrides in pnpm-workspace.yaml and expo-doctor hold the alignment), so they get their own group and major updates are reviewed by hand.
Major updates open one pull request each so they can be reviewed on their own.
Workflow actions are pinned to full commit SHAs and updated in one weekly group.
Askida server: one weekly pull request for every minor and patch update of the Composer dependencies; the composer.json ranges stay, only composer.lock moves.
Askida app: one weekly pull request for every minor and patch update of the Flutter (pub) dependencies; the pubspec.yaml ranges stay, only pubspec.lock moves.
Askida app: Android Gradle dependencies (Play Integrity and the build plugins) in one weekly group.
Askida: major updates of Composer, pub and Gradle dependencies open one pull request each so they can be reviewed on their own.
node-forge (ADR-0043) and braces (ADR-0078) carry the two advisories ignored in pnpm-workspace.yaml; no patched release exists, so no update is proposed until the ADRs are reviewed.
